treasury.description: Review wallet liquidity and deploy USDC into institutional yield strategies.
treasury.walletDescription: Available balances in your connected Solana wallet.
treasury.strategiesDescription: Compare indicative rates and manage each mock position independently.
treasury.transactionDescriptionDeposit: Enter the absolute amount of USDC you want to deploy.
treasury.transactionDescriptionWithdraw: Enter the absolute amount of USDC value you want to return to your wallet.
treasury.pyusdSwapDescription: This deposit includes an atomic swap from USDC into PYUSD before funds enter the strategy.
treasury.invalidAmount: Enter a USDC amount greater than zero.
treasury.insufficientWalletBalance: This deposit is greater than the USDC available in your wallet.
treasury.insufficientStrategyBalance: This withdrawal is greater than your balance in this strategy.
treasury.indicativeRateDisclosure: APYs are illustrative, variable rates for this mock experience. Deposits and withdrawals update browser state only and do not submit transactions.

earnProgram.introTitle: Choose the yield strategy your customers will see
earnProgram.introDescription: Earn Program is built for B2B2C integrations. Your team adds a deposit button to its web or mobile experience, and customer deposits flow into the strategy configured here.
earnProgram.selectDescription: Choose one strategy to surface behind your customer-facing deposit button.
earnProgram.rateDisclosure: APYs are illustrative, variable rates for this mock experience. Your selected strategy becomes the destination behind the embedded deposit flow.
earnProgram.overviewDescription: Review the customer deposit buttons configured for your products.
earnProgram.storageDisclosure: These configurations and deposit totals are mock data stored only in this browser.
earnProgram.builderDescription: Preview the same deposit action across iOS and web, then create a handoff link for your engineering team.
earnProgram.appearanceDescription: Choose a starting treatment. A future playground will let you adjust the button CSS and component styling before acceptance.
earnProgram.previewPrompt: Put your balance to work with one tap.
earnProgram.integrationDescription: Copy this link and share it with your engineering team. It represents the future integration guide with iOS and web code snippets for this button.
earnProgram.copyFailed: The integration link could not be copied.
earnProgram.handoffHint: Prototype only — the destination page is not implemented yet.
earnProgram.saveFailed: The mock button could not be saved in this browser.
earnProgram.missingStrategyDescription: Return to Earn Program and select the strategy this button should fund.

overview.programDescription: What you have earning right now. Each one is funded and withdrawn on its own, and every balance is read live.
overview.holdingsEmpty: No deposits detected yet. Funds land as cash, then deploy toward the strategy on the provider's later rebalances.
overview.activityRebalanceComplete: Rebalance complete — your program is back on target
overview.activityFailed: The provider reports a problem with your program. Check the status before retrying.
overview.withdrawalCompleted: Withdrawal complete — funds have settled to your address
overview.withdrawalPartiallyCompleted: Withdrawal only partly settled. Check the amount paid before retrying.
overview.withdrawalFailed: Withdrawal failed — no funds left your program. Check the reason before retrying.
overview.withdrawalCancelled: Withdrawal cancelled — no funds left your program.
overview.withdrawalPendingApproval: Withdrawal is waiting on an approval signature.
overview.programLoadError: The earn program could not be loaded.
overview.providerNotConfigured: Live earn data is unavailable in this environment — the provider API key is not configured yet.
overview.catalogueLoadError: The strategy catalogue could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
overview.catalogueEmpty: No strategies are available in this environment yet.
overview.rateDisclosure: APY figures are variable and shown for comparison only. Actual rates and redemption times are set by the provider.
overview.depositAddressLabel: Deposit — send USDC on Solana to
overview.cashDeploys: Deploys toward the strategy on a later rebalance — small amounts may stay as cash

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Funds leave the shared portfolio and settle to a Solana address you control.
withdraw.availableUnavailable: Couldn't check the available balance. You can still withdraw — the provider confirms the amount when you submit.
withdraw.createdDescription: The withdrawal is processing. Funds settle to the destination address once the provider completes it.
withdraw.errorAmountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
withdraw.errorExceedsCeiling: More than the {amount} available as {token} right now.
withdraw.previewInsufficient: The provider can't fill this {token} withdrawal — the withdrawable balance may sit in the other stablecoin. Try a smaller amount or switch stablecoin.
withdraw.previewInsufficientCeiling: The provider can pay {amount} as {token} right now. Enter that or less.
withdraw.previewNoSolanaPayout: {token} doesn't pay out on Solana — the provider settles {token} withdrawals on Ethereum only. Withdraw USDC instead.

playground.amountOptional: Optional. Omit to ask what this lane can pay right now.
playground.requestIdRequired: Required UUIDv4 idempotency key — a retry must reuse it.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.description: Ways to put idle stablecoins to work. Compare what each one pays, how it's backed, and how fast you can withdraw — rank by pool size or APY.

deposit.walletTitle: Choose the wallet that funds this program
deposit.walletDescription: Deposits are sent from this wallet, and withdrawals come back to it.
deposit.walletCustodyTitle: You keep custody until you deposit
deposit.walletCustodyBody: The program gets its own provider-managed Solana deposit address. Nothing moves until you send stablecoins to it.
deposit.walletsLoadError: Your wallets could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
deposit.walletsEmptyBody: Create one in the Wallets module first — the deposit flow needs a wallet to send from.
deposit.connectFireblocksBody: Provision an institutional wallet on Fireblocks, then start this deposit again.
deposit.strategyDescription: Compare the available strategies by backing, access, pool size, and APY.
deposit.strategiesEmpty: No strategies are available in this environment yet.
deposit.strategiesLoadError: The strategy catalogue could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
deposit.strategyEnvironmentUnavailable: This strategy is hosted on {environment} and cannot be deposited into from this project.
deposit.strategyProviderUnavailable: This provider is available for catalogue browsing but does not support this deposit flow yet.
deposit.strategyAssetUnavailable: This strategy does not use a stablecoin supported by this deposit flow.
deposit.strategyAvailabilityDisclosure: Strategies that cannot be funded from this project remain visible for comparison.
deposit.reviewDescription: Nothing has moved yet. Confirming sets the program's strategy.
deposit.routingBody: Every {token} deposit routes fully into this strategy. Deposits in other stablecoins keep whatever allocation they have today.
deposit.createBody: Confirming provisions one provider-managed wallet for your organization in this environment and sets its strategy.
deposit.updateBody: Your program already exists. Confirming replaces the {token} target immediately; existing balances move toward it on the provider's later rebalances.
deposit.rateDisclosure: APY is variable and shown for comparison only. Actual rates and redemption times are set by the provider.
deposit.integrationTitle: Drive this program from your API
deposit.integrationDescription: Your organization has API keys, so everything you just did is available programmatically. These are live endpoints.
deposit.integrationAuthNote: Authenticate with your secret key as a bearer token. Secrets are never shown here — only the prefix you created.
deposit.liveDescription: Send stablecoins on Solana to the address below. Funds arrive as cash, then deploy toward {strategy} on the provider's later rebalances.
deposit.depositAddressBody: Send {token} on Solana to this address. Deposits are detected automatically.
deposit.walletCreatingBody: This usually takes under a minute. The deposit address appears here as soon as it is ready.
deposit.walletFailed: The program wallet reports a problem. Try again shortly, or contact support if it persists.
deposit.depositsEmpty: No deposits yet. Transfers appear here shortly after they land on-chain.
deposit.depositsLoadError: Deposits could not be loaded. They refresh automatically.
deposit.connectFireblocksLockedBody: Fireblocks needs to be activated for your organization before you can provision a wallet on it.
deposit.timingDisclosure: Confirming saves the target immediately, but money moves on the provider's later rebalances — not instantly. Slower strategies can take hours to converge, and small balances may stay as cash where deploying them isn't economical.
deposit.programMissing: That strategy could not be found — it may have been changed or removed since this link was made. Head back to Earn to see your current strategies.
deposit.creationUnavailable: Earn strategies are open for comparison only right now — no provider is accepting deposits, so there is no strategy to set up. Head back to Earn to browse what is listed.
